correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Schur complement of the zero-indexed Fourier table, exact local K^-1=q^-1 conjugate bicharacter, zeta factorization H=ZDZ^T on partial nonzero assignments and Boolean-interval Möbius inverse. Entrywise summation gives the union-support cutoff and binomial sum. Counting ordered pairs by support union gives the Frobenius formula. Fixed q,r, the origin inverse entry dominates all others by a full n-power and H approaches all-ones in Frobenius norm, hence the stated sharp n^(2r) constant and singular-vector localization. Independently checked exact two-sided inverse products in q2 n3 r1, q2 n4 r2, q3 n2 r1; these tests are finite corroboration.
